description: Irodori-TTSの読み上げを教師にしたF0ヘッドだけで抑揚を作る日本語の抑揚モデル（v10と混ぜない、自然の振れ幅、全体を-50cent）。同じモデルのエネルギーヘッドでモーラの音量（0.75〜1.3倍）も変える。アクセント特徴とモーラの予測はv10を使う

provenance.training_corpus: Irodori-TTS v4.1-Small readings of jsut-label BASIC5000 and UtauTTS everyday sentences (4521 utterances after reading checks) + Tsukuyomi-chan Corpus Vol.1 and みんなで作るJSUTコーパスbasic5000 BASIC5000_0001-0600 (700 utterances)
provenance.teacher_f0: WORLD Harvest (10 ms, 80-800 Hz) with octave-error folding, frames below max-40 dB excluded, 20 ms Gaussian smoothing, utterance median at 0
provenance.training: train-speech-timing --f0 --f0-teacher (natural scale), F0 dilations 1-64 x2, window 1000, plan-timed copies (--plan-augment), 24000 steps, best valid at 22750
